project: AI in European Hospitality: The Playbook for Hospitality Stakeholders (EHL SBP Group 36 for HFTP)

format.page: A4 portrait, read as two-page spreads
format.dpi_note: 96 px per inch; 1588 x 1123 px = two A4 pages side by side

rules: Only these sizes exist. No other font size may appear.
Sentence case everywhere except kickers and divider titles.
Section colour is used only for: kickers, rules and bars, key numbers, chart highlight, divider, page furniture.
Body text is always ink; secondary text is muted.
Text on a section colour is white and must pass WCAG AA (4.5:1); darken the colour by 10% steps until it passes.
All positions and gaps are multiples of 4 px.
Content never enters the margins except full-bleed images and dividers.

page_title.name: Numbered chapter
page_title.spec: Section number (e.g. 2.3) in section colour at display size beside the title; title in display font, ink colour, max 2 lines.

subheading.name: Kicker + heading
subheading.spec: Subheading = small-caps kicker (caption size, tracked 0.12em, section colour) above an h2 in display font.

key_figure.name: Tinted tile
key_figure.spec: Key figure in a tile filled with 10% section colour, 16 px padding, 6 px radius; number in section colour.

source.name: Numbered footnote
source.spec: Superscript reference after the figure; source and base in numbered notes at the page foot.

chart.name: Labelled bars
chart.spec: Horizontal bars, direct value labels at bar end, highlight bar in section colour, others in rule-dark grey, no axis or grid.

page_furniture.name: Top tab
page_furniture.spec: Top-left tab in section colour with white section number and name (caption size, capitals).

section_divider.name: Colour panel + photo
section_divider.description: Left page a solid section-colour panel with a big number and the chapter contents; right page the photo.

layout_library.name: Lead + two columns + figures
layout_library.description: Left page: title, lead and two text columns. Right page: key figures and a chart.

layout_library.name: Card grid
layout_library.description: Six cards in a grid: for use cases, departments or countries.

layout_library.name: Pull-quote spread
layout_library.description: Text with a large pull quote breaking across the spread.

image_layouts.name: Half-spread photo
image_layouts.description: One page is a full-bleed photo, the other carries the text.

image_layouts.name: Strip of three
image_layouts.description: Three photos in a row with short captions. For cases or examples.

image_layouts.name: Photo + quote band
image_layouts.description: A full-width photo with a coloured band holding a pull quote.

image_layouts.name: Inset in column
image_layouts.description: A smaller photo inside the text column; text continues beside it.

content_rules: Every number carries its source and its base (who was asked, how many, how weighted) right next to it, including headline tiles.
Each page tells one finding: the title states it, the page proves it.
No filler: if content does not fit the layout limits, cut it or split the page; never shrink type.

notes.density: keep margin left and right from center line
notes.title: keep acccent rule + numbered section
notes.source: in text should be numbered and for figures, it should appear in the box small in the lower part of the box
notes.furn: can we make both of them at the same time? the vertical strip is useful for quick navigation inside the file
